svg.title: Pranit Bhandari | Founder & Full-Stack Engineer
svg.desc: Founder of Purple Star Private Limited. Building a multi-tenant Dealer Management System for importers and dealerships. React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB and Linux. A dot-matrix PB monogram appears beside the profile. Decorative animations respect reduced-motion preferences.

g.text: Building tools that businesses run on.
